passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our audited consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes thereto, included in Item 8. — Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Form 10-K. In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect our plans, estimates, and beliefs that involve significant risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to those differences include those discussed below and elsewhere in Item 1A. — Risk Factors and Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements of this Form 10-K. Except for per MMBtu amounts, or as otherwise specified, dollar amounts presented within tables are stated in millions. During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company's sales and shipping business met the criteria to be a reportable segment. Prior to the year ended December 31, 2025, sales and shipping was not quantitatively material for reporting purposes and was combined with corporate activities as corporate, other and eliminations. Prior period presentations included within Item 7. –– Management's discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of this form 10-K has been recast to conform to the current segment reporting structure. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: — Risks Relating to Regulation and Litigation — If we are unsuccessful in any current or potential future legal proceedings with customers, the amounts that we are required to pay may be substantial or certain of our post-COD SPAs may be terminated, which may lead to an acceleration of all our debt for the relevant project and adversely impact the trading price of our Class A common stock , Note 4 – Revenue from Contracts with Customers in Item 8.— Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Form 10-K, and Part I Item 3.— Legal Proceedings of this Form 10-K. Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates Use of Estimates The preparation of the consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported in the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. We evaluate our assumptions on an ongoing basis. The accounting policies and estimates discussed below are considered by our management to be critical to an understanding of our financial statements as their application requires the most significant judgments from management in estimating matters for financial reporting that are inherently uncertain. While we believe the estimates used in the preparation of the consolidated financial statements are appropriate, actual results could differ from these estimates. Revenue from Contracts with Customers The transaction price defined in our contracts for the sale of LNG to third-party customers includes both fixed and variable components including variable consideration for contingent payments for non-performance, delays, or other damages, which may be due from the Company and could result in the significant reversal of revenue. Any estimates for contingent payments are recognized as a reduction to the transaction price until the future significant reversal of revenue is no longer probable of occurring or once the uncertainty is resolved. For further discussion, see Item 8. — Financial Statements and Supplementary Data —Note 4 – Revenue from Contracts with Customers of this Form 10-K, for more information. Critical Accounting Policies Revenue Recognition The majority of our nameplate capacity produced at our projects after COD will be sold under long-term 20-year Contracted SPAs. We aim to market and sell the expected nameplate capacity at our subsequent projects under a combination of long-term 20-year SPAs as well as short- and medium-term contracts to optimize the average fixed liquefaction fee across our SPAs. Delivery under post-COD SPAs commences upon achieving COD of the respective LNG facilities, which has only occurred for our Calcasieu Project. Delivery under our Firm-start SPAs commences upon a contractually defined date. credit_strengths.text: Operating income and cash flow expanded sharply year over year, driven by Plaquemines ramp-up and Calcasieu COD, lifting operating margin well above the sector median. This earnings momentum supports internal cash generation, though the durability of higher volumes and pricing remains to be tested.

Interest coverage sits comfortably above the sector median, reflecting robust operating income relative to interest expense. This provides a cushion against earnings volatility, although coverage could compress if debt-funded capex continues and rates remain elevated.

key_risks.text: Legal proceedings with customers could result in substantial payments or termination of post-COD SPAs, which may accelerate project debt and pressure liquidity. This is a concrete risk factor disclosed by the issuer, and any adverse outcome could impair the capital structure and refinancing prospects.

Debt maturities are heavily weighted to later years, with a large balloon after year five, but the near-term profile includes a modest current portion. Refinancing risk is concentrated in the medium term, and the company's ability to term out debt depends on project cash flows and market access.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow is deeply negative as capital expenditures far exceed operating cash flow, consuming all internal liquidity and requiring external funding. This negative free cash flow to debt ratio indicates that debt service currently relies on financing rather than organic cash generation.

Leverage is elevated and sits above the sector median on a net basis, with an indicative financial risk profile of highly leveraged. The current ratio is below one, highlighting a working capital deficit that could strain short-term liquidity if capex remains elevated.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer's credit profile is constrained by high leverage, negative free cash flow, and a working capital deficit, despite strong operating momentum and above-median interest coverage. The indicative financial risk profile is highly leveraged, and the Altman Z double prime zone signals distress, warranting a cautious stance.

Forward-looking, the credit trajectory hinges on completing growth projects and stabilizing cash flows. If capex moderates and volumes sustain, deleveraging could occur; otherwise, reliance on debt markets and potential legal liabilities may pressure ratings. Shareholder distributions absorb a modest portion of cash flow, but negative free cash flow limits flexibility.

credit_strengths.text: 營運收入及現金流按年大幅擴張，主要受 Plaquemines 產能爬坡及 Calcasieu 商業運營日帶動，令營運利潤率遠高於行業中位數。此盈利動力支持內部現金生成，惟較高銷量及定價之持續性仍有待驗證。
利息覆蓋率穩居行業中位數之上，反映營運收入相對利息支出穩健。此為盈利波動提供緩衝，惟若債務融資資本開支持續且利率維持高企，覆蓋率或會受壓。

key_risks.text: 與客戶之法律程序可能導致巨額付款或商業運營日後買賣協議終止，或會加速項目債務到期並對流動性構成壓力。此為發行人披露之具體風險因素，任何不利結果均可能損害資本結構及再融資前景。
債務到期日嚴重集中於後期，五年後有巨額氣球還款，惟近期部分包括一筆溫和之流動部分。再融資風險集中於中期，而公司將債務延長期限之能力取決於項目現金流及市場准入。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流嚴重為負，因資本開支遠超營運現金流，耗盡所有內部流動性並需外部融資。此負自由現金流對債務比率顯示，債務償付目前依賴融資而非內生現金生成。
槓桿高企，按淨額基準高於行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿。流動比率低於一，凸顯營運資金赤字，若資本開支維持高企，或會對短期流動性構成壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人之信用狀況受高槓桿、負自由現金流及營運資金赤字所限制，儘管營運動力強勁且利息覆蓋率高於中位數。指示性財務風險狀況為高度槓桿，而 Altman Z 雙撇號區域顯示困境，值得採取審慎立場。
前瞻而言，信用軌跡取決於完成增長項目及穩定現金流。若資本開支放緩且銷量持續，或可去槓桿；否則，依賴債務市場及潛在法律責任或會對評級構成壓力。股東分派佔現金流一小部分，惟負自由現金流限制靈活性。
